title: Why Is Hertz (HTZ) Stock Rocketing Higher Today
summary: Shares of global car rental company Hertz (NASDAQ:HTZ) jumped 5.4% in the afternoon session after the company announced an expanded technology partnership with Verra Mobility to modernize its fleet operations, alongside receiving investment-grade ratings on new vehicle financing notes.

title: Verra Mobility and Hertz Expand Technology Partnership Under Renewed Contract
summary: Verra Mobility Corporation (NASDAQ: VRRM), a leading provider of smart mobility technology solutions, and The Hertz Corporation, on behalf of its Hertz, Dollar, and Thrifty brands, shared additional details today regarding their recent contract renewal, including plans to explore new technology solutions that build on their long-standing tolling and violations management partnership.

title: Verra Mobility (VRRM) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut After Avis Reset And Analyst Caution
summary: Verra Mobility is back in focus after analysts reduced its implied fair value from US$9.71 to US$7.00, bringing expectations closer to recent single digit price targets. Much of Wall Street remains split, with Neutral and Hold style ratings reflecting a tug of war between contract losses, renewed agreements and fresh wins like Los Angeles.
